## Pull requests are not accepted

Thanks for the interest — but this project doesn't take outside code contributions. It's
single-maintainer by design, and a pull request will be closed unmerged regardless of its quality.
That's not a judgement of the work; it's said here so you find out before writing it rather than
after. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/PedroMealha/eidos-ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for
the full reasoning.

**What genuinely helps instead:**

- **[Open an issue](https://github.com/PedroMealha/eidos-ui/issues)** describing your use case. This
  is the most useful thing you can do — it's how the roadmap actually gets set.
- **Override it locally.** Every design token is a CSS custom property and every component exposes
  `eidos-<name>` class names, so appearance can be changed without touching library source. See the
  Theming section of the README.
- **Fork it.** The licence is MIT, so diverging is entirely permitted.

Found a security issue? Please report it privately instead — see
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/PedroMealha/eidos-ui/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
